content: Water will rise to the height of the lily that floats upon it; so will a human rise to the height of their own aspirations.
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation: A person's true stature is not determined by external circumstance, but by the elevated noble ideals and inner determination they choose to harbor.
practicalInsight: Upgrade your internal self-image today. Set your moral and creative aspirations higher than your comfortable baseline.
reflectionPrompt: What lofty standard could I live up to if I stopped settling for mediocrity?
